verdict.rationale: The repo states that adapters stay unmerged and that one read-only base serves multiple adapter sets. Upgrading adapters swaps only the adapter files, and an OpenAI-compatible `edge0 serve` endpoint exists. However, the shipped LoRAs are distillation adapters for recovering quantization loss, not general user adapters. There is no documentation on how several adapters are selected or served together. missing for 10: per-request adapter selection or routing in the serve API, concurrent multi-adapter serving or hot-swap at runtime, loading custom third-party LoRAs, efficiency or throughput evidence for multi-adapter serving, independent or hands-on corroboration.
